Name: Dark Aura
Effect: Increase 2 dice to all Damage Pools of Dark-Type Moves of all Pokémon in the field. This effect does not stack with itself. Pokémon and Trainers on the field will not cooperate with each other. Unique Ability.
Description: A powerful black aura comes out of this Pokémon, Shrouding the field in darkness and filling everyone's hearts with evil, selfishness and corruption.
